about.title: Quiet luxury, made for every woman
about.p1: AURELIA was born from a simple frustration — luxury handbags were either impossibly expensive, or built to shout rather than speak. We wanted neither.
about.p2: Every piece we design starts with restraint: soft, sculpted silhouettes, considered hardware, and materials chosen to age gracefully. No logos. No trend cycles. Just pieces meant to become part of your everyday, for years.
about.p3: Designed with women across Algeria in mind, AURELIA delivers nationwide with cash on delivery — because trust should never be a barrier to owning something beautiful.

items.q: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
items.a: Yes — COD is available on every order, across all 58 wilayas in Algeria.
2–5 business days depending on your wilaya. You'll receive a call to confirm before dispatch.
All AURELIA bags use premium vegan leather with brushed or polished hardware, chosen for durability and a soft hand-feel.

items.q: Can I return or exchange my order?
items.a: Yes, within 7 days of delivery, provided the item is unused and in original packaging.

items.q: How do I track my order?
items.a: Visit the Order Tracking page and enter your order number, sent to you via SMS after confirmation.
